title: Junior Payroll Assistant
description:
Through proprietary software and AI, along with a focus on customer delight, Sleek makes the back-office easy for micro SMEs.

We give Entrepreneurs time back to focus on what they love doing - growing their business and being with customers. With a surging number of Entrepreneurs globally, we are innovating in a highly lucrative space.

We operate across 3 business segments:

Corporate Secretary: Automating the company incorporation, secretarial, filing, Nominee Director, mailroom and immigration processes via custom online robots and SleekSign. We are the market leaders in Singapore with ~5% market share of all new business incorporations

Accounting & Bookkeeping: Redefining what it means to do Accounting, Bookkeeping, Tax and Payroll thanks to our proprietary SleekBooks ledger, AI tools and exceptional customer service

FinTech payments: Overcoming a key challenge for Entrepreneurs by offering digital banking services to new businesses

Sleek launched in 2017 and now has around 17,500 customers across our offices in Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia and the UK. We have around 600 staff with an intact startup mindset. We have recently raised Series B financing off the back of >70% compound annual growth in Revenue over the last 5 years. Sleek has been recognised by The Financial Times, The Straits Times, Forbes and LinkedIn as one of the fastest growing companies in Asia. Backed by world-class investors, we are on track to be one of the few cash flow positive, tech-enabled unicorns based out of Asia Pacific.

Mission of the role

To ensure the accurate, timely, and compliant processing of payroll for multiple UK clients. The UK Payroll Executive will be responsible for managing payroll data, processing payroll transactions, supporting workplace pension auto-enrolment, responding to client queries, and ensuring all payroll activities are completed in line with UK labour laws, HMRC requirements, tax regulations, and agreed client timelines.

The role requires strong attention to detail, client service, ownership, and the ability to manage multiple payrolls and deadlines efficiently while continuously looking for ways to improve workflows through technology, AI, and automation.

Key outcomes In the first 6â12 monthsOutcome 1: UK Payroll Knowledge & Process Proficiency

Develop a strong foundational understanding of UK payroll regulations and processes and confidently apply the appropriate rules when preparing and processing client payrolls.

Become fully familiar with Sleek's internal payroll platforms and processes, including HMRC submissions such as RTI, FPS and EPS, workplace pension submissions, and year-end reporting requirements including P60s and P11Ds by the third month.

Outcome 2: Accurate & Compliant Payroll Processing

Process assigned client payrolls accurately and within agreed timelines, ensuring all payroll data is complete and correctly validated before submission.

Ensure 100% compliance with agreed payroll and statutory deadlines, including payroll runs, pension auto-enrolment submissions, and applicable HMRC requirements.

Identify discrepancies or potential issues early, take ownership of resolving them, and maintain high standards of confidentiality and data accuracy.

Outcome 3: Client Service & Responsiveness

Maintain a high level of client satisfaction by providing prompt, accurate, and professional responses to payroll-related queries.

Consistently achieve a CSAT target of at least 97% month-on-month while ensuring that client queries and emails are responded to within the agreed communication SLA, with no non-reply tickets or emails left unresolved at the end of the working day.

Build trusted relationships with clients by providing clear updates, proactively following up on outstanding information, and handling difficult conversations positively when required.

Outcome 4: Team Collaboration & Process Improvement

Work effectively with the UK Payroll team and other internal departments to ensure smooth payroll operations and timely resolution of client or processing issues.

Contribute to improving payroll processes and operational efficiency by identifying opportunities to use AI, automation, payroll technology, and improved workflows to reduce manual work, improve accuracy, and increase turnaround times.

Must-have experience

  • Minimum 1â2 years of hands-on UK payroll processing experience.
  • Experience working in a bureau, outsourced payroll environment, or shared services centre is preferred.
  • Experience managing multiple client payroll accounts is an advantage.
  • Working knowledge of UK payroll processes, HMRC requirements, tax regulations, and workplace pension processes.
  • Experience with payroll software such as BrightPay, Xero Payroll, or similar is an advantage.
  • Strong attention to detail and experience working with sensitive and confidential financial information.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and meet strict deadlines.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Comfortable working with data and payroll-related reporting and metrics.
  • Practical experience or strong interest in using AI tools, automation, and IT applications to improve daily workflows.

Must-have attributes

Ownership & Accountability: Takes full responsibility for assigned payrolls and client accounts, follows through on tasks without constant supervision, and proactively resolves issues or roadblocks.

Humility: Open to feedback, willing to learn, and comfortable acknowledging knowledge gaps and seeking support when required.

Structured Thinking: Able to organise multiple client payrolls, deadlines, queries, and tasks in a clear and logical manner, while using sound judgement to prioritise competing requirements.

Data Driven & Attention to Detail: Comfortable working with numbers and payroll data, with a strong focus on accuracy. Able to identify discrepancies, missing information, or inconsistencies before they impact payroll processing or clients.

Can Have Tough Conversations in a Positive Way: Able to communicate clearly and professionally when dealing with sensitive payroll issues, missing information, delays, or difficult client situations while maintaining a constructive client relationship.

AI & Tech Savvy: Energetic about adopting new software, AI tools, automation, and technology to make payroll processes more efficient and effective.

Behavioural fit is also important at Sleek, and we will be looking for candidates that have a proven track record of embodying the below attributes in their recent roles:

We will be looking for candidates who have a proven track record of embodying the below attributes in their recent roles:

Ownership: This shows reliability and helps build trust within the team. We move fast and need to know that everyone will see things through to completion and proactively help to get things back on track when challenges arise. Accountability is really important to us.

Humility: There is so much we don't know. Humility allows for open-mindedness to feedback and a willingness to learn from others. It paves the way for collaboration and creates a positive work environment. It is a key ingredient of self-awareness and emotional intelligence.

Structured Thinking: Our business is complex with many layers (many services, many countries, many cultures). Regardless of whether you're more analytical or creative in nature, being able to show sound judgement is important to us. It ensures solutions are pragmatic and balance the needs of the organisation, team and customers.

Attention to detail: You'll be managing multiple client payrolls, deadlines, queries, and workstreams. It will be important for you to keep track of everything and notice when information is missing, inconsistent, or likely to cause an issue.

Excellent listener and clear communicator: We have a variety of nationalities and for many people, English isn't their first language. For you to excel, you'll need to be present in your calls and make sure you properly receive and thoughtfully send messages to others in the business.

The interview process

The successful candidate will participate in the following interview stages. We anticipate the process to last no more than 3 weeks from start to finish.

TA Screen / One-way Video Interview: Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a one-way video interview to assess spoken and written communication, relevant UK payroll experience, motivation, and initial background.

Technical Round: A 30-minute interview and practical assessment with the Hiring Team to assess UK payroll knowledge, payroll processing experience, attention to detail, ability to work with payroll data, and understanding of UK payroll processes and deadlines.

Soft Skills Round: A 30-minute chat with a member of the leadership team to evaluate real-world work scenarios against our core behavioural values, including ownership, humility, structured thinking, communication, and ability to handle challenging situations.

Reference Verification: Prior to final offer confirmation, we will conduct one professional reference check with your recent direct manager or supervisor. To keep the process moving smoothly, this step may be initiated during the final interview stages.

Requirement for background screening

Please be aware that Sleek is a regulated entity and as such is required to perform different levels of background checks on staff depending on their role. This may include using external vendors to verify:

  • Your education
  • Any criminal history
  • Any political exposure
  • Any bankruptcy or adverse credit history

We will ask for your consent before conducting these checks. Depending on your role at Sleek, an adverse result on one of these checks may prohibit you from passing probation.

By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Data Privacy Statement for Candidates, found at Sleek.com.

Some other great things about working at Sleekâ¦

Humility and kindness: Humility is a core attribute we hire for, which means we have a culture of not taking ourselves too seriously and being able to laugh. Kindness is also incredibly important. We are committed to creating and nurturing a diverse and inclusive environment.Â 

Flexibility: Youâll be able to work remotely. If you need to start early or start late to cater to your family or other needs, we donât mind, so long as you get your work done and proactively communicate. You can also work fully remote from anywhere in the world for 1 month each year

Financial benefits: We pay competitive market salaries and provide staff with generous paid time off and holiday schedules. Certain staff at Sleek are also eligible for our employee share ownership plan and can share in the upside of our stellar growth trajectory as we work toward listing on a prominent stock exchange in the Asia Pacific region.

Personal growth: Youâll get a lot of responsibility and autonomy at Sleek - we move at a fast pace so youâll be making decisions, making mistakes and learning. Thereâs also a range of internal and external facing training programmes we run. Weâre also at the forefront of utilising AI in our space and are developing a regional centre of AI excellence. It is our intention that if you leave Sleek, you leave as a more well-rounded person and professional.

Sleek is also a proudly certified B Corp. Â Since we started our journey in 2017, weâve been committed to building Sleek as a force for good. In just over 5 years, weâve joined a community of industry leaders like Patagonia, Ben & Jerry's, and P&G who are building an inclusive, equitable, and a regenerative economy.

title: Customer Experience Representative
organisation: Prop Firm Match Global â FZCO
description:
About PFM
Prop Firm Match Global FZCO is a leading platform for discovering, comparing, and selecting top proprietary trading firms. We provide traders with tools and features to easily compare challenge details, read verified reviews, see accurate payout data, and much more. We're a fast-moving, fully remote team with members from all around the world caring deeply about the quality of what we build. Our culture values ownership, clear communication, and practical impact over fluff.

About the department
Customer Experience is the front line of PFM. We're the team traders turn to when something isn't working, when they need clarity on a firm, a promotion, or their loyalty rewards, or when a payout question needs a real answer. We work across Intercom, Discord, and email to keep response times fast without losing quality and every ticket we close well is a small deposit in the trust traders place in PFM and in the firms we work with.

About the role
Deliver timely, accurate, and empathetic support that enables traders to confidently use Prop Firm Match while maintaining trust with both customers and partner firms. This role ensures every customer interaction contributes to a positive experience and protects the reputation of PFM.

Performance objectives

Objective 1 -Â  Deliver exceptional customer experience
Own this outcome end to end, translating it into clear priorities, coordinated execution, and measurable results.

Typical tasks:

  • Respond to customer inquiries across Intercom tickets, Discord, and email.
  • Review and resolve customer issues end to end.
  • Tailor tone and approach to each customer's situation without sacrificing accuracy.

Success looks like
Customers receive accurate, professional, and empathetic support with high satisfaction.


Objective 2 -Â  Maintain operational excellence
Own this outcome end to end, translating it into clear priorities, coordinated execution, and measurable results.

Typical tasks:

  • Prioritize incoming tickets and follow established workflows.
  • Document cases and keep customer records up to date.
  • Escalate issues to the right team when they fall outside scope.

Success looks like
SLAs are consistently met while maintaining quality and minimizing escalations.

Objective 3 -Â  Ensure information accuracy
Own this outcome end to end, translating it into clear priorities, coordinated execution, and measurable results.

Typical tasks:

  • Verify offers, promo codes, and loyalty program submissions before responding.
  • Stay current on firm rules, payout information, and policies.
  • Keep FAQs and internal documentation accurate and current.

Success looks like
Customers receive consistent and up-to-date information regarding firms, promotions, loyalty rewards, and platform features.

Objective 4 -Â  Support continuous improvement
Own this outcome end to end, translating it into clear priorities, coordinated execution, and measurable results.

Typical tasks:

  • Report bugs and flag recurring issues to Product and Development.
  • Suggest workflow improvements based on patterns you notice.
  • Contribute to knowledge base updates and AI training data.

Success looks like
Customer feedback drives product and process improvements.


What we look for

Must have

  • Minimum 2 years of customer support or other client-facing experience, ideally in a remote, high-volume environment.
  • Strong written communication: able to explain things clearly and empathetically to non-technical customers.
  • Hands-on experience with Intercom or a similar helpdesk/ticketing platform.
  • High attention to detail: comfortable verifying specifics (promo codes, payout terms, policy language) before responding.
  • Strong time management, with the discipline to hit response-time and handling-time targets without cutting corners on quality.
  • Comfortable investigating and troubleshooting an issue independently before escalating it.
  • Professional, accountable, and collaborative: works well across teams without needing heavy oversight.
  • Available to work CET-aligned hours in a fully remote, async-first environment.

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with proprietary trading firms or the prop trading industry.
  • Experience using AI-assisted support tools (e.g., Intercom Fin AI or similar) -Â  kept here as a nice-to-have rather than dropped entirely, since it's still worth listing as a plus.
  • Experience managing or responding to public reviews (e.g., Trustpilot).
  • Background in fintech, SaaS, or another fast-paced digital consumer platform.

Compensation

  • up to $800 - $1,300 USD / month gross

Location & work setup

  • Â Remote, worldwide, with strong overlap with CET hours.
  • Â Employment type: Full-time.

Hiring stages
We keep our process simple, transparent, and respectful of your time. Here's what to expect:

  • Application screening
    We carefully review all applications to identify candidates whose background aligns with the role's requirements. You'll receive a timely and transparent update on your application status.
  • Video intro + role fit questionnaire
    A short async step -Â  no scheduling required. You'll record a brief video introduction and complete a written questionnaire, helping us understand your background and fit without either side committing to a live call upfront.
  • Discovery HR Interview
    A conversation with our HR team focused on company and culture match -Â  how PFM works, what remote ownership looks like day to day, and what success in this role looks like.
  • Real-world task
    A short, scoped exercise based on real PFM support scenarios, giving both sides a realistic view of the work before committing further.
  • Professional interview
    A conversation with the Head of Customer Experience focused on your support experience, problem-solving approach, and how you handle real user situations -Â  including firm-comparison neutrality and integrity judgment calls.
  • Peer & values conversation
    A conversation with a peer from across the team focused on values, culture, and how you work best. You'll have plenty of space to ask questions and get a real feel for life at PFM.

    • If there's a strong mutual match, we start with an informal conversation to align on expectations, then follow up with a formal written offer. Full transparency throughout, and time for you to make an informed decision.
    To keep things fully transparent and mutually fair, we complete a reference check before the formal offer is extended. No surprises - just part of how we make careful, informed decisions on both sides.
